full_judgment:
3. The opposite parties as defendants filed written objection against the application for temporary injunction. Their case was that CS Khatian No. 115 is a big holding containing many plots. CS Plot No. 180 was measuring 2.97 acres of land. The plaintiff petitioners purchased some land from the said plot No. 180 and are the owners of the same. The defendants also purchased some other portions of plot No. 180 and thereby they have become the owners of the same. Other persons also are owning and possessing the balance land of the said plot No. 180. This CS plot No. 180 was never partitioned by metes and bounds and till that date it was in ejmali. The owners by purchase have been enjoying their respective shares by amicable arrangement. If the suit plot is demarcated and partitioned, all the co-sharers will get separate road in their Saham. There is no easement right of the plaintiffs in the disputed roads. The eastern boundary of the defendants is marshy land and the eastern side is the petitioners land. So, the question of plaintiffs using the defendants land for going to eastern boundary of the defendants land, which runs to the southern boundary of the plaintiffs land, does not arise at all and the plaintiffs have not been using the said roads. 

 10. Mr. Delwer Hossain has also submitted before us the RS Khatian Nos. 1675 DP and 1623 DP. From these two RS khatians it appears that RS plot No. 1923 is road and RS Plot No. 1927 is also road. When RS operation was made, those two disputed small roads were recorded as roads giving two separate plot numbers, namely, 1923 and 1927. Copy of the RS map was also produced before the court which clearly shows that RS plot No. 1927 is road and RS plot No. 1923 is also a road. One Mst. Ajeri Khatun's name was recorded in DP khatian No. 2054, the name of Rafique Ahmed was recorded on DP khatian No.1662 and the name of one Ekramunnessa was recorded in DP Khatian No. 34 as they all purchased some portions of the aforesaid CS plot No. 180 and in all these Khatians the plot Nos. 1923 and 1927 were shown as roads. So, the aforesaid papers as filed by Mr. Delwer Hossain clearly show that in the recent RS Khatian the two disputed roads were recorded as road vide plot Nos. 1923 and 1927. The opposite parties failed to raise any objection regarding their two registered sale deeds, RS records of right and RS Map showing the two disputed roads as RS plot Nos. 1923 and 1927.
